name: B10-0041/2024 (Verts/ALE) – The case of José Daniel Ferrier García in Cuba
title: Resolution on the case of José Daniel Ferrer García in Cuba
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of José Daniel Ferrer, a Cuban opposition leader held since July 2021, and all other political prisoners in Cuba. It asks Cuba to respect human rights, allow peaceful protest and free speech, and let outside monitors visit. It also urges the European Union to publicly condemn his detention and asks the United States to lift its embargo on Cuba. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament asks Cuba to free Ferrer and other political prisoners.
- **Who it affects:** Ferrer, other Cuban prisoners, and Cuba's government.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to EU bodies and Cuba's government; no action is guaranteed.
